description: This Java source file defines a command handler class for deleting savings account applications within the Apache Fineract project. The class is annotated as a Spring service, implements a command handler interface, and processes delete commands by invoking the appropriate service method.

classes.name: SavingsAccountApplicationDeletionCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles delete commands for savings account applications, delegating the deletion process to the SavingsApplicationProcessWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by calling the deleteApplication method on the injected service with the entity ID.
